({{langx|he|מכבי קריית גת}}) was an Israeli football team based in the southern city of [[Kiryat Gat]]. The club's best achievement has been promotion to the [[Israeli Premier League|Premier League]] as [[Liga Leumit]] runners-up in 2001, after beating [[Hapoel Beit She'an F.C.|Hapoel Beit She'an]] on the final day of the season. However, in their first season in the top division, they finished at the bottom of the table, six points from safety, and were relegated back to the second tier. As a result of the overspending while in the top division, the club suffered financial difficulties, and was demoted to the [[Liga Alef|fourth division]] by the [[Israel Football Association|IFA]] in 2004, where they played for a decade until 2014, when they were promoted to Liga Leumit."}}
